mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.post_id, r.user_id, r.reason, r.description, r.status, r.severity, r.created_at, u.username, p.title AS post_title FROM reports r JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.id JOIN posts p ON r.post_id = p.id WHERE r.id = #{id}
